title: Polynomial-time map from the reduction
statement: Fix a Boolean circuit encoding and an output-sensitive PCPP reduction, and suppose its generated proof lengths are bounded by a polynomial in circuit size. The reduction’s output function, viewed as a map from finite binary strings to finite binary strings, is a polynomial-time map.
hypotheses_covered: An output-sensitive PCPP reduction for that encoding
A polynomial bound on generated proof lengths in circuit size
